_about: How to reach each variant dungeon record, written for this tracker from the facts of each route (which path, which choices). Facts checked against the Console Games Wiki's route tables (2026-11-08); the wording is our own.
Whom the Silkie Serves: Left path. Solve the two-eyes puzzle (blue sack right of the north door, yellow sack in the far south-east corner). After the teleporter, clear the enemies and open the door hidden behind the rubble before Nanamo opens the gate.
Pride and Acceptance: Left path. Solve the two-eyes puzzle (blue sack right of the north door, yellow sack in the far south-east corner), then let Nanamo open the gate without interfering.
A Spot in the Sunlight: Left path. Fail the two-eyes puzzle. In the next room, hit every cotton spore while fighting the enemies.
A Key Memory: Left path. Fail the two-eyes puzzle, then carry on while avoiding every cotton spore.
In Father's Stead: Right path. Go left on the lift; at the blocking door pick the first answer, "The blessed spark".
Ul'dah's Sin to Bear: Right path. Go left on the lift; at the blocking door pick the second answer, "The sacred fire".
To Learn More of Myrrh: Right path. After the first boss take the lift right; kill the drakes from biggest to smallest (father, mother, brother, sister, drakeling). After the wraiths, use the Myrrh Incense Burner on the right of that room, then the sarcophagus, and defeat the boss.
Ul'dah and Sil'dih: Middle path. Fail the scale puzzle, fight the last boss and pull the right lever.
Raising the Flag: Middle path. Fail the scale puzzle, fight the last boss and pull the left lever.
My Mother's Eyes: Middle path. Solve the scales (helm on the left, fruit on the right); in the next chamber use the Nald statue.
The Thorne Legacy: Middle path. Solve the scales (helm on the left, fruit on the right); in the next chamber use the Thal statue.
In Parchment We Trust: Right path, secret boss (Thorne Knight). Do the Myrrh route: drakes from biggest to smallest, then the incense burner. At the sarcophagus, target it and use /bow, /respect, /vpose, /kneel in that order, then defeat the boss.
Gift of the Onmyoji: Left path. In the crystal ball room use the orb without turning the statues. In the next room close the case after Hancock looks at it.
The Crimson Sword: Left path. In the crystal ball room use the orb without turning the statues. In the next room leave the case alone after Hancock looks at it.
A Tale of Dead Men: Left path. Turn the Seiryu statue to face east (toward Suzaku) and the Suzaku statue to face south (the big doors), then use the orb. In the last pack of the Upper Pagoda, let the Apa finish casting Water III before killing it.
Forging a Legacy: Left path. Turn the Seiryu statue to face east (toward Suzaku) and the Suzaku statue to face south (the big doors), then use the orb. In the last pack of the Upper Pagoda, kill or interrupt the Apa before it casts Water III.
The Luthier and the Songstress: Middle path. Before the second boss, clear the enemies and answer "Deal" when asked whether to spare the baboon.
Lost to Avarice: Middle path. Before the second boss, clear the enemies and answer "Think about it" when asked whether to spare the baboon.
Beyond the Lanterns' Light: Middle path. After the tiger, climb the crates and overhangs and pull the rope at the top; wait upstairs for Hancock, then kill the lantern enemies normally.
The Common Man's Courage: Right path. Ignore the Rokkon Sentinel; after the first boss, touch all four Stones of Protection along the way.
Sound of the Stone: Right path. Ignore both the Rokkon Sentinel and the Stones of Protection.
The Seal of Silence: Right path. Talk to the Rokkon Sentinel to free the dogu from the tree; use /easternbow at the unmarked shrine by the fallen tree and place the dogu there; later use the Iwakura.
Seasons of the Fleeting: Right path. Talk to the Rokkon Sentinel to free the dogu from the tree; use /easternbow at the unmarked shrine by the fallen tree and place the dogu there; later use the Ancient Tree instead of the Iwakura.
The Ogiseru's Fate: Middle path, secret boss (Enenra). After the tiger, climb the crates and pull the rope; wait upstairs for Hancock. Pull the three lantern enemies down the stairs and kill each one while it faces one of the three unlit lanterns by the yellow-patterned wall (they cast a cone when they die).
A Not-quite Deserted Island: Left path. Refuse Matsya's request to fish, and do not help Zozone (he runs off at zero health).
The First Settlers of Aloalo Island: Left path. Refuse Matsya's request to fish, and keep Zozone alive (heal him, Variant Cure works, or hold the enemies' attention).
God of Heaven and Sea: Left path. Let Matsya fish; later dig in the patch of sand on the right for a Southern Sow Bug.
A Noxious Gift: Left path. Let Matsya fish; later search the mound of rocks on the left for a Southern Worm.
The Roots of Arcanima: Middle path. Go straight through, kill the enemies and interact with nothing.
Under the Boughs of the Great Tree: Middle path. At the second and third packs after the first boss, walk into the red-flowered bushes and scare off the armadillos at the end of each hidden path.
A Dear Friend: Middle path. After the first boss kill the treant first, then every caterpillar on the sigil. In the last pack, do not hit J'jhimei behind the left wood golem; wait for the golems to wake.
Fish for the Mind: Middle path. After the first boss kill the treant first, then every caterpillar on the sigil. In the last pack, also hit J'jhimei behind the left wood golem.
A Familiar History: Right path. Accept Statice's offer, use the portal she makes, and walk into her whoopee-cushion prank.
The Remnants of Faith: Right path. Accept Statice's offer, use the portal and kill the six raptors; in the next hallway take the vine-covered tunnel on the right to the crocodile room, avoiding the whoopee cushion. (Also works by refusing her three times, opening no chests, ignoring the animal statues and pulling the lever.)
A Lalafell or a Fish?: Right path. Refuse Statice's offer three times, open a treasure box and kill the mimics, ignore the animal statues and pull the lever.
Wellspring of Golden Memories: Right path, secret boss (Loquloqui). Refuse Statice three times and do the three statue rituals (one minute each, only the player with the buff): Sparrow: /say O dancer of the skies, hear me. then /blowkiss, circle once clockwise (turtle, whale, sparrow), /dance. Whale: /say O messenger from beyond the horizon, hear me. circle once clockwise (sparrow, turtle, whale) then once counterclockwise, /dance. Turtle: /say O wayfarer of land and sea, hear me. circle twice counterclockwise (sparrow, whale, turtle), /bow. Follow Matsya through the secret passage, take the leather sack from Whasbyrm, and before the last boss set the statues: sparrow farthest, whale middle, turtle nearest.
A Land of Abundance: Left path. After the first boss, use the damaged fence by the spoils coffer; wait at the bird nest and hit the Willful Wind before it finishes casting Flee.
A Carpet Soars: Left path. After the first boss, use the damaged fence by the spoils coffer; let the Willful Wind take the apple and carry on.
A Foe of Flame: Left path. After the first boss, go through the gate and let the Wisp's area attack hit you beside the damaged stone railing on the left; take the path through the broken railing.
Fragrant Fruits: Left path. After the first boss, go through the gate and carry on without interacting with anything.
The Sunlit Expanse: Right path. After the first boss tell Y'nazqha "The seaweed won't steer us wrong."; let the goobbue's Inhale swallow all four clusters of colourful rocks.
Treasure at the Ocean's Floor: Right path. After the first boss tell Y'nazqha "The seaweed won't steer us wrong."; kill the goobbue before it swallows all the rocks.
Ruler of the Radiant Sea: Right path. After the first boss tell Y'nazqha "I'd fancy a stroll on the beach."; after the first pack, use the Giant Conch Shell.
The Ocean's Bounty: Right path. After the first boss tell Y'nazqha "I'd fancy a stroll on the beach."; leave the Giant Conch Shell alone and go on to the boss.
Valley of Extremes: Middle path. After the first boss tell Y'nazqha "Let the mushrooms guide us true!"; make the Stone Puppet's Magnetic Rock (a small circle on its target) hit all three big rock clusters in the cave.
A Blade Engraven: Middle path. After the first boss tell Y'nazqha "Let the mushrooms guide us true!"; kill the Stone Puppet without lighting the rock clusters.
Master of the Unyielding Blade: Middle path. After the first boss tell Y'nazqha "Floating rocks warrant a closer look."; stand by each of the three big rocks on the platforms until they glow (a path on the west side reaches the upper one).
In a Harsh Nature: Middle path. After the first boss tell Y'nazqha "Floating rocks warrant a closer look."; keep away from the big rocks.
The Eye of the Beholder: Right path, secret record. After the first boss tell Y'nazqha "The seaweed won't steer us wrong." At the Shimmering Stage altar before the seaweed barrier, /bow to raise five coloured panels, /say I am returned! and stand on four panels in order: coral (green), conch (purple), starfish (magenta), pearl (blue).
